reader.requirement: At --std 85 every execution of a relative-file DELETE must update the I-O status of the file (00 success, 23 no such record, 43 sequential access without a prior successful READ, 49 file not open I-O) and store it in the FILE STATUS item before any declarative or phrase runs.

edition-consulted.switches: sharing default ALL OTHER at 85 (no 51 lock conflict arises between a 1985 program's connectors)

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectBehaviors over RelativeConnector.cs, FileRegistry.cs DELETE bodies and KeyedIoEmitter#EmitDelete; the status codes are chosen without an edition; every status set is a 1985 status (VIII.1.3.4 defines 00, 23, 43, 49)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f23_02/03 cover statuses; this probe adds 49 on a never-opened file and 43 twice in a row

probes.expected: status updated by each DELETE (GR7) to the VIII.1.3.4 value

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.4.3.4 GR7  (4.3.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR7
OK  §1985:VIII.4.3.4 GR2  (4.3.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR2

reader.notes: EmitDelete calls SeqIo.EmitStoreFileStatus right after the governed runtime call, before the USE hook and the phrase pair, so the declarative sees the new status (FUSE=49, QUSE=43). Identical at --std 2023.

refuter.evidence: refute-1985-132/rseq.cob (rseq-001), sequential access with USE procedure: DELETE open OUTPUT 49 and open EXTEND 49 (USE ran first: QUSE=49); READ then WRITE on ANOTHER file then DELETE 00 (GR2 counts file-name-1 only); READ, REWRITE 00, DELETE 43; READ, START 00, DELETE 43; READ, failed WRITE 48, DELETE 43; DELETE inside IF with END-DELETE 00. rctl.cob: RELATIVE KEY 9(18) at 999999999999999999 and at 0 give 23. Each status is a §1985:VIII.1.3.4 value (43 text: 'the last input-output statement executed for the file ... was not a successfully executed READ'). The '43' gate drops at the FileConnector.Status setter for every outcome, re-armed only by ReadSucceeded. Not probed: a sequential DELETE whose READ record another connector removed (runtime answers 23); 1985 is silent on two connectors over one file, so that is implementor latitude, not evidence. cite.py: OK §1985:VIII.4.3.4 GR7; OK §1985:VIII.4.3.4 GR2.
